description: A bare first section, then the full part. At 90 BPM, for four bars, the course project at this stage plays a first section of 16 steps with only the bass and a second of 16 steps with the bass, the phrase and the quiet pickup, repeating as a song. Listen for the bass alone for the first bar, then the melody entering over it at the second bar, and the two sections looping.
